name: Conversion Funnel Analyzer
summary: Calculates stage-to-stage conversion and drop-off from your funnel counts, and finds the biggest absolute and relative leaks.
description: Reads the count of people at each stage of a funnel (visit, signup, activation, purchase...) and calculates conversion and drop-off between every pair of stages, overall conversion, and the stages with the largest absolute and relative drop-off. Stages with zero people get no conversion rate instead of a division error, and increases between stages are flagged as a data problem. Who it's for: growth, product and marketing teams deciding where to focus funnel work. Limitations: it assumes the stages measure the same people in order over the same period; it compares counts only and does not explain why people drop off.
problems: Where do users drop off in our signup funnel
Which funnel step leaks the most
Calculate conversion rates between funnel stages
